acceptance: Keep the cycle open until Director completes implementation-plan Tasks 1 and 2 as two commits, the verify-request cites one fresh implementer, spec reviewer, and quality reviewer for each task with dispositions, Operator returns GO for the exact implementation range, and both Pair-B preflight reports are reconciled.
Treat Operator NITS or FAIL, either preflight contradiction, a changed write set, a newer route, or invalid capacity/route state as a reroute condition rather than closeout.
Close only with capacity-board, route-validation, protocol-doctor, smoke, implementation-range, Operator-verdict, and Pair-B-preflight evidence.

The route commit may correct only the approved plan's base/ADR/reviewer/preflight contradictions found by independent semantic review; do not author production fixes, consume coordinator mail, create signed refs or keys, activate a remote signer, or publish remote refs as coordinator.
